title: Recalibrate harmonic chroma and radius orchestration for component library
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Context: Our component library has accumulated ad-hoc color variants and multiple corner-radius presets over time. This has led to inconsistent visual weight across buttons, cards, tables, and chart overlays. The goal of this ticket is to define a harmonic chroma system (a small set of perceptually-balanced swatches with programmable tone steps) and a radius orchestration pattern (a small number of radius tokens plus composition rules) that improve accessibility, reduce token cardinality, and enable predictable scaling for dense and spacious layouts.
acceptance_criteria: 1) A documented harmonic chroma palette with 6 semantic anchors (neutral, accent, success, warning, danger, subtle) and 3 tone steps each (base, elevated, muted); 2) A radius orchestration spec with 4 tokens (none, small, medium, large) and composition rules for nested surfaces; 3) Migration guide mapping existing tokens to new anchors with visual diffs for primary components (buttons, cards, table rows, chart tooltips); 4) Automated visual regression tests for 12 key component states; 5) Accessibility contrast report demonstrating AA compliance for base/elevated combinations where required.
design_notes:
- Use perceptual color adjustments (OKLAB/OKLCH) to compute tone steps so that chroma remains stable across lightness changes.
- Prefer chroma-preserving desaturation for muted steps rather than fixed gray overlays.
- Radius orchestration: define composition rule where nested cards subtract one radius step to preserve inner corner rhythm; dialogs and modals keep 'large' radius by default.
- Introduce 'shell' vs 'content' surface semantics: shell surfaces (global panels) should use larger radius and subdued chroma; content surfaces (cards, table rows) use medium radius and stronger tone anchors.
- Chart overlays (tooltips / legend chips) use the muted tone step of the corresponding semantic anchor to avoid visual competition with chart marks.
proposed_token_changes:
- tokens/color/neutral/{base,elevated,muted}: replace 12 legacy neutrals with 3-step neutral anchor.
- tokens/color/accent/{base,elevated,muted}: introduce hue-anchored accent with adjusted chroma for dark/light modes.
- tokens/radius/{none,sm,md,lg}: new canonical radius set (0,4,8,12 px).
- tokens/elevation/shadow-1..3: recalibrate blur and offset to pair with new radii (smaller radii use tighter shadows).
- tokens/alias/button/primary -> maps to accent/base + radius/md; button/secondary -> neutral/elevated + radius/sm.
rollout_plan:
Phase 1 (Design + Spec) - complete token definitions, perceptual tests, and mapping doc (this ticket). Phase 2 (Engineers) - land token alias changes and feature flags behind 'new-tokens' flag, update storybook primitives, and run visual regressions. Phase 3 (Canary) - enable for internal apps and Dedicated console subset, collect telemetry on UI regression dashboard. Phase 4 (Gradual) - full rollout with migration scripts and deprecation schedule for legacy tokens.
Estimate timeline: ~6 weeks from spec sign-off to full rollout; aim for runtime-1.20 compatibility for feature flags.
